ex.en: The majority of members voted in favour of the new budget.
ex.zh: 大多数成员投票支持新预算。

words.note: the majority of 后接复数名词，谓语随之用复数。

ex.en: We dragged the heavy box across the floor to the door.
ex.zh: 我们把沉重的箱子拖过地板，拉到门口。

words.note: drag one's feet 指故意拖延，drag out 指拖长。

ex.en: The roof is covered with zinc sheets that shine in the sun.
ex.zh: 屋顶覆盖着在阳光下闪亮的锌板。

words.note: 不可数名词，指锌，化学符号为 Zn。

ex.en: The children wore colourful costumes in the school play last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚孩子们在学校演出中穿着色彩鲜艳的戏服。

words.note: 指戏服或民族服装，不指日常穿的衣服。

ex.en: The city has clamped down on cars parked on the pavement.
ex.zh: 该市已严厉打击在人行道上停车的行为。

words.note: clamp down on 指严厉打击，本义是用夹具夹紧。

ex.en: The company issued a statement denying the rumours about layoffs.
ex.zh: 公司发表声明，否认有关裁员的传言。

words.note: 作名词指议题，作动词指发布、发放。

ex.en: He showed great maturity in the way he handled the criticism.
ex.zh: 他处理批评的方式显示出极大的成熟。

words.note: 指成熟，reach maturity 表达到成熟期。

ex.en: They searched in vain for the missing child for three days.
ex.zh: 他们搜寻了三天，仍未找到走失的孩子。

words.note: in vain 指徒劳无功，vain 也可指自负的。

ex.en: The government issued a decree banning single-use plastics.
ex.zh: 政府颁布法令，禁止使用一次性塑料制品。

words.note: 指官方法令或判决，语气正式，多用于政府。

ex.en: The group works on wildlife conservation in the mountains.
ex.zh: 该组织从事山区的野生动物保护工作。

words.note: 指保护与节约，注意与 conversation 区分。

ex.en: He took a part-time job to supplement his income.
ex.zh: 他做了一份兼职来补贴收入。

words.note: 作动词指补充增补，名词指补充物或增刊。

ex.en: In contrast to his brother, Tom enjoys quiet evenings at home.
ex.zh: 与弟弟不同，汤姆喜欢在家安静地度过夜晚。

words.note: in contrast to 表对比，by contrast 表相比之下。

ex.en: The jury reached a verdict after six hours of discussion.
ex.zh: 陪审团经过六小时讨论后作出裁决。

words.note: 指陪审团的裁定，也可指最终的定论。

ex.en: He turned up the stereo and the whole room shook.
ex.zh: 他把音响的声音调大，整个房间都震动了。

words.note: 指立体声音响，in stereo 表以立体声播放。

ex.en: Some drivers openly defy the speed limits in this area.
ex.zh: 这一地区有些司机公然违反限速规定。

words.note: 指违抗；defy description 表美得难以描述。

ex.en: The party has never questioned its basic economic doctrine.
ex.zh: 该党从未质疑过自己的基本经济信条。

words.note: 指教义或主义，多用于宗教、政治领域。

ex.en: Please read the first paragraph and answer the questions below.
ex.zh: 请阅读第一段，并回答下面的问题。

words.note: 由 para-(旁)加 graph(写)构成，指段落。

ex.en: A senior official was sent to mediate between the two sides.
ex.zh: 一位高级官员被派去在双方之间调解。

words.note: mediate between 指在双方间调解，名词为 mediator。

ex.en: She moved abroad in pursuit of a better career.
ex.zh: 为了追求更好的职业，她移居国外。

words.note: in pursuit of 表追求，动词形式为 pursue。

ex.en: In ancient times people often turned to a prophet for guidance.
ex.zh: 古时候人们常向先知寻求指引。

words.note: 指先知、预言者，注意与 profit 区分。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can create a vicious cycle of stress and illness.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会造成压力与疾病的恶性循环。

words.note: 指循环或自行车，vicious cycle 指恶性循环。

ex.en: The speakers amplified her voice so that everyone could hear.
ex.zh: 扩音器把她的声音放大，让每个人都能听见。

words.note: 指放大声音，也指增强效果或详述观点。

ex.en: Higher salaries lured many young engineers to the private sector.
ex.zh: 更高的薪水吸引了许多年轻工程师进入私营部门。

words.note: lure sb into doing 指诱使某人做某事，多含贬义。

ex.en: Proper waste disposal is a serious problem in many cities.
ex.zh: 妥善处理垃圾在许多城市都是严峻的问题。

words.note: at sb's disposal 表供某人使用，也指处理。

ex.en: The two firms reached a settlement out of court last week.
ex.zh: 两家公司上周在庭外达成和解。

words.note: reach a settlement 指达成和解，动词为 settle。

ex.en: The dancers whirled around the floor to the music.
ex.zh: 舞者们伴着音乐在地板上旋转。

words.note: 指快速旋转，也指思绪纷乱；in a whirl 表忙乱。

ex.en: As the flood waters receded, villagers returned to their homes.
ex.zh: 洪水退去后，村民返回了家园。

words.note: 指潮水退去、记忆变淡或发际线后移。

ex.en: She studied English literature at university and later became a teacher.
ex.zh: 她在大学学习英国文学，后来当了老师。

words.note: 指文学或文献，为不可数名词，没有复数形式。

ex.en: It took me a while to digest all the information in the report.
ex.zh: 我花了一段时间才消化报告中的全部信息。

words.note: 作动词读 /daɪˈdʒest/，作名词时指文摘。

ex.en: Sales slumped sharply after the new tax was introduced.
ex.zh: 新税实施后销量大幅下跌。

words.note: 指销量、价格暴跌，也指经济萧条期。
